text: We teach girls to shrink themselves, to make themselves smaller. We say to girls, you can have ambition, but not too much.
author: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie

text: I am not free while any woman is unfree, even when her shackles are very different from my own.
author: Audre Lorde

text: There is no limit to what we, as women, can accomplish.
author: Michelle Obama

text: Feminism is the radical notion that women are human beings.
author: Cheris Kramarae

text: A feminist is anyone who recognizes the equality and full humanity of women and men.
author: Gloria Steinem

text: Women belong in all places where decisions are being made. It shouldn't be that women are the exception.
author: Ruth Bader Ginsburg

text: The most common way people give up their power is by thinking they don't have any.
author: Alice Walker

text: I raise up my voice—not so I can shout, but so that those without a voice can be heard.
author: Malala Yousafzai

text: Each time a woman stands up for herself, without knowing it possibly, without claiming it, she stands up for all women.
author: Maya Angelou

text: No country can ever truly flourish if it stifles the potential of its women and deprives itself of the contributions of half of its citizens.
author: Michelle Obama
